segments.title: 第172章 求求你了
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 172: I'm Begging You

"Huh? Class President, you're here too?"

As Xu Youyu followed Li Luo toward the drum set, Shao Youpeng, who was teaching someone else to play bass, noticed her instantly.

Actually, Xu Youyu was no longer his class president.

Xu Youyu had chosen the liberal arts stream during class redistribution and was now in Class 16.

Shao Youpeng, on the other hand, had remained in Class 1.

But upon seeing Xu Youyu, he still subconsciously blurted out the title "Class President."

Hearing Shao Youpeng's greeting, Xu Youyu gave him a polite nod.

But this seemed to energize Shao Youpeng, who quickly asked, "Class President, want to try the bass? I can teach you."

Hearing this, Xu Youyu immediately shook her head and politely declined, "No, thanks. You go on with what you're doing. There are still people in line waiting."

After speaking, she pointed at Li Luo, "Someone said he's going to teach me how to play the drums. I'm here to see if he's bluffing."

"Ah?" Shao Youpeng was taken aback for a moment, then said with a laugh, "Li Luo must be joking, right? He's never even touched a drum set, how could he possibly know how to play?"

"Is that so?" Xu Youyu looked puzzled, but still followed Li Luo over to Niu Qingling's side.

She saw Li Luo grinning as he said to Niu Qingling, "Sister Niu, can I borrow the drums for a bit?"

"Hmm?" Niu Qingling was bored out of her mind. When she saw Li Luo walk over, she wondered what he was up to, only to find out he wanted to borrow the drum set. "You know how to play this too?"

"Just a little." Li Luo made a gesture, pinching his index finger and thumb together, and said modestly, "But it should be enough to fool some amateurs."

"Then go ahead." Niu Qingling was one to enjoy a good show and didn't mind stirring things up. She immediately gave up her seat and said with a chuckle, "Have you practiced before?"

"A little bit."

Though it was in his mind.

Li Luo sat down in front of the drum set, picked up the two drumsticks with a relaxed motion, placed his feet on the control pedals, and quickly got into the zone.

Shao Youpeng and Xie Shuchen both looked over with curiosity. Yan Zhusheng also stopped playing his guitar and turned to look at Li Luo.

But Li Luo just smiled at them. Then, while raising his drumsticks, he shouted, "Ready, one, two, three, go!"

As his voice fell, his movements followed.

The familiar rhythm of the drums instantly reached the ears of Shao Youpeng and the others.

Driven by the tacit understanding they had built over many days, the group, including Yan Zhusheng, immediately got into the groove. Following the beat of the drums, they quickly launched into the opening of the song "Brave Heart."

Niu Qingling stared at the relaxed Li Luo with a look of astonishment, never expecting this guy to be so deceptively skilled.

His drumming level felt like it was no worse than her own.

If Li Luo knew what Niu Qingling was surprised about, he would probably feel a little embarrassed.

After all, he was borrowing Niu Qingling's muscle memory, completely replicating it one-to-one.

With the boost from the Soul Possession Mode, the effect was practically identical to the original person playing.

However, since he was supposed to be teaching Xu Youyu how to play, Li Luo only led Shao Youpeng and the others for a minute or two before stopping, signaling for them to continue letting other students try the instruments.

Then, Li Luo turned to Xu Youyu with a smile, "Senior, what do you think? Want to give it a try?"

"Can I?" Xu Youyu walked to Li Luo's side, curiously examining the drum set. "How do you do this?"

"Come sit here first."

Li Luo gave his seat to her. After Xu Youyu sat down, he handed her one drumstick and kept one for himself.

"This is the bass drum. You press the pedal with your foot. Each time you press it, it'll make a sound." Li Luo pointed to Xu Youyu's right foot. "Right, just like that."

Xu Youyu tried stepping on it a few times. Hearing the dull thud of the bass drum, her interest was piqued. "And then?"

"Let's keep it simple. Now look at this drum." Li Luo pointed to the large drum directly in front of Xu Youyu. "This is called the snare drum. Hit it right here with the drumstick in your hand."

Following his instruction, Xu Youyu raised her drumstick and struck it once.

"Don't be so tense, relax your arm a bit." Li Luo patted Xu Youyu's shoulder and arm, his entire upper body leaning over her head, loosely embracing her from behind. "Try again."

"Like this?" After all, the two of them had been living under the same roof for several months. Xu Youyu didn't even mind Li Luo being so close, she just followed his instructions and hit the snare drum again.

"Very good. Now do as I say." Li Luo held out his own drumstick and said to Xu Youyu, "Now follow my rhythm. When I hit, you hit. Let's do it together."

Thump, thump, thump.

The snare drum began to sound in a simple monotone.

Li Luo patiently guided Xu Youyu, and once she grew familiar with the rhythm, he had her stop temporarily. Then he said, "Same rhythm as just now. Don't use your hands yet, just hit the bass drum with your foot. Follow my rhythm."

With that, Li Luo continued to strike the snare drum, while Xu Youyu, as instructed, began to press the pedal, keeping in time with his snare hits.

"Great, just like that." Li Luo smiled. "Now I'm going to stop, but don't you stop with your foot, okay?"

Xu Youyu nodded.

So Li Luo stopped his movements, and only the sound of the bass drum remained.

Once Xu Youyu got used to this rhythm, Li Luo suddenly reached out with his own drumstick again, interspersing snare hits into the bass drum rhythm.

And so, one bass drum beat, one snare drum beat, they sounded in alternation.

The foundation of a rhythm began to take shape. "Excellent. Keep the rhythm with your foot, and now follow my hand movements. Come on." Li Luo's left hand reached out and supported Xu Youyu's arm that held the drumstick, guiding her to strike the snare drum.

This action made the two of them look even more intimate.

When Shao Youpeng caught a glimpse of this scene, he was instantly filled with envy and jealousy, and a bit of indignation.

That dog Li Luo, wasn't Yan Zhusheng enough for him? Why was he hitting on his dear Class President now?

This was going too far!

But seeing that Xu Youyu had no intention of resisting, Shao Youpeng could only let sour feelings bubble up inside him, fantasizing about how wonderful it would be if he were the one teaching Xu Youyu to play the drums like this.

But reality was cruel.

Li Luo and Xu Youyu didn't even notice Shao Youpeng's gaze.

Once Xu Youyu was able to grasp the rhythm on her own, with the bass drum and snare drum alternating to form a basic rhythmic framework.

Li Luo's drumstick was freed up, and at the same time, his left foot pressed the control pedal for the hi-hat cymbal.

As Xu Youyu's steady rhythm progressed, Li Luo would intersperse drum fills and the timbre of the hi-hat from time to time.

Instantly, the originally monotonous rhythm came alive in Xu Youyu's ears.

Even though all she was doing were simple and mechanical repetitive motions, when combined with Li Luo's playing, it could create such a wonderful feeling.

This caused her to become completely immersed, having the time of her life.

It wasn't until a member of the Student Council ran in from outside, found Xu Youyu, and said that she was needed for something, that Xu Youyu snapped back from her enthusiasm.

Reluctantly, she returned the drumstick to Niu Qingling. Xu Youyu stood up and said to Li Luo, "I have something to do, so I can only stay for this long. I'm leaving now."

"Is something wrong?" Li Luo looked at the student who had run over and asked curiously.

"Two boys started fighting over at the basketball court," the student said helplessly. "Senior, you should go have a look."

"A fight?" Xu Youyu frowned. "Got it. Let's go over now."

Seeing this, Li Luo also said goodbye to Niu Qingling, told Yan Zhusheng he was leaving, and then followed Xu Youyu towards the basketball court.

"What are you following me for?" Xu Youyu asked, confused.

"Didn't you say there was a fight?" Li Luo raised his eyebrows. "Of course I'm going to watch the show."

"You..." Xu Youyu was speechless. "You really love to stir things up, don't you."

Unfortunately, by the time Li Luo and Xu Youyu arrived on the scene, the two had long since been pulled apart by people breaking up the fight.

As the president of the Student Council, Xu Youyu went forward to understand the situation. She learned that the dispute was caused by cutting in line and fighting over a hoop on the court. She first had the injured student sent to the infirmary, then reported the situation to the Dean of Students.

By the time everything was handled, more than half an hour had passed.

"Phew... I'm exhausted." Xu Youyu sighed and sat down on a bench beside the basketball court.

Li Luo handed her a bottle of water.

"Thanks." Xu Youyu took the water and chugged down a large gulp.

"Looks like you're really busy."

"You really think I'm just lazing around?" Xu Youyu shot him a glare.

"Weren't you pretty free this morning? You even had time to watch us draw lots."

"Heh." Xu Youyu couldn't be bothered to argue with him. She just gazed out at the lively scene at the school. "I wouldn't have become the president if I'd known it'd be this much trouble."

"Do you want to play, Senior?" Li Luo pointed to the basketball court. "Just like in the gymnasium just now."

"What?" Xu Youyu turned to look at him. "Does my dear junior actually have time to accompany me?"

"I'm free right now." Li Luo said, "Didn't I just run all over the place with you? I haven't had a chance to look around this afternoon either."

"Then it's not you accompanying me, but me accompanying you." Xu Youyu started to laugh. "I'll agree if you beg me."

Li Luo looked at her, speechless. But when he recalled the pure, happy smile on Xu Youyu's face when she was playing the drums in the gym, he couldn't help but say, "I'm begging you, Senior. Please hang out with me for a while."

"Hmm... since you've put it that way." Xu Youyu smiled and stood up from the bench, patting her bottom lightly. Then, with a wave of her hand, she said, "Then I'll reluctantly play with you for a bit."

"Ha." Li Luo chuckled, stood up as well, and walked toward the basketball court. "So, shall we shoot some hoops first?"

"No problem, let's go."

On the lawn in the southwest corner of the sports field, Qiao Xinyan, having just returned from the restroom to their picnic spot, sat down next to Ying Chanxi and said to her:

"Xixi, I think I saw Li Luo just now."

"Hmm? Over by the gymnasium?"

"Not there, at the basketball court." Qiao Xinyan said, "But maybe I was mistaken. It was pretty far away."

"You must have been mistaken. I already told him." Ying Chanxi said with a smile, "He said that after things wrap up with the Rock Club, if he has time, he'll come find us here."

"Oh, is that so? Then I probably saw wrong."

(End of this chapter)
